additional_info.subject: 0430494 - ID0430494-DC/Si-D/AE-[Multiple]Need firmware version v7.0.5-0-Update CRM:00314000182
additional_info.body:
Good evening Basheer,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
0430494.
The ticket was created to updated the chargers from UAEV customer to FW v7.0.5, and it reached L3 queue for issues on updating few chargers.
From the list you provided, all chargers have been updated to v7.0.5, but:
MP / r8 170002423
is offline on SCB since 12.06.2025
MP / R8 170002529
was offline since this weekend. Now it is online and I am currently updating it to v7.0.5
MP / R8 170002516
is on v6.1.3 with v7.0.5 rolled out. However, I see the charger is in FAILSAFE MODE. Therefore, before launching the update it is necessary to check the charger, otherwise the update will not be successful. I checked the charger via SSH, and I can see that there is no communication with router XF4 and ecoG Main KF11. As both components are not reachable, I am suspecting an issue on the cables or switches, but it could also be both components have an issue.
It is necessary therefore to go onsite and check XF4 and KF11 of charger
MP / R8 170002516
. I would suggest, just in case, to bring both components as spare parts.
Please let me know if you need further support for this charger.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: 0430494 - ID0430494-DC/Si-D/AE-[Multiple]Need firmware version v7.0.5-0-Update CRM:00314000182
additional_info.body:
Good morning Thangal,
As per my previous email on ticket
ID0430494
for FW update to v7.0.5 of the chargers of UAEV. Kindly waiting for feedback from your side.
The chargers have been updated to v7.0.5, a part from #3 chargers:
MP / r8 170002423
is offline on SCB since 12.06.2025
MP / R8 170002529
was offline for some time. On 23.06 it came back online and I tried to upgrade the FW via SSH, however unsuccessful due to a very weak signal. The charger then went offline on 24.06
MP / R8 170002516
is on v6.1.3 with v7.0.5 rolled out. However, I see the charger is in FAILSAFE MODE. Therefore, before launching the update it is necessary to check the charger, otherwise the update will not be successful. I checked the charger via SSH, and I can see that there is no communication with router XF4 and EcoG Main KF11. As both components are not reachable, I am suspecting an issue on the cables or switches, but it could also be both components have an issue.
Can you please provide me a feedback on these topics? Are you planning an onsite visit for all 3 chargers?
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
